title: Augur: Measuring When Predicting Data Makes It Faster to Move (code, data and measurements)
description: Open-source testbed and measurements for the paper "Augur: Measuring When Predicting Data Makes It Faster to Move". Includes a byte-bounded cache, sequential, stride and Markov predictors, a confidence-gated prefetch scheduler, a trace-driven storage simulator, a real-I/O replay harness with cold-cache control, an exact integer-only context-mixing codec (augur-cm), a closed-form wire-time model, raw results, and the paper source. Experiment design, code and drafting were carried out with substantial assistance from Claude, an AI assistant from Anthropic; the author is responsible for the content.
